fears.title: A renovation shouldn't turn into stress
fears.subtitle: We discuss the important details in advance so you can feel confident in the result and avoid unnecessary stress, delays and expense.
fears.missionText: to make the process clear, predictable and comfortable for you at every stage of work.
fears.ctaNote: We'll reply personally, with no scripts or pressure.
fears.guarantee: We fix the project scope, timeline and cost before work begins.

items.fear: I'm afraid of going over budget
items.answer: We help choose solutions that fit the real renovation cost and discuss priorities in advance.

items.fear: I'm afraid the interior will be inconvenient
items.answer: We think through storage, passages, light and your family's living scenarios at the layout stage.

items.fear: I don't understand how to hand the project to builders
items.answer: We prepare clear materials for implementation and stay in touch after the handover.

items.fear: I'm afraid no one will answer after the project
items.answer: We support the client and help you calmly get through the implementation stage.

items.fear: What if I need to change something
items.answer: Adjustments are discussed calmly and recorded - without chaos or endless reworks.

faq.title: The questions we get asked most
faq.subtitle: We answer the important questions about work, timelines and the process.

items.a: A measured survey plan, two layout options, furniture and equipment placement, and black-and-white 3D views. The rate is {{planning}}. Working drawings, collages and photorealistic visualizations are excluded.

items.q: How do Drawings and Drawings + collages differ?
items.a: Both include the layout and a set of working drawings. The second adds room-by-room collages and a more detailed specification. Photorealistic visualizations are excluded from both.

items.q: Does Layout + visualizations include working drawings?
items.a: No. It includes a measured plan, two layout options, furniture placement, black-and-white 3D views and photorealistic room visualizations. Working drawings and collages are excluded.

items.q: Does the full project include implementation?
items.a: The full design project costs {{full}} and includes the layout, collages, visualizations of the main rooms, working drawings and specifications. Supervision, procurement and implementation are paid separately.

items.q: How does the calculator handle extra services?
items.a: 3D visualizations are added only when the selected package does not already include them. Supervision costs {{supervision}}. Monthly charges, procurement and consultations quoted on request are excluded from the project subtotal.

items.q: How accurate is the estimate, and how long does a project take?
items.a: The calculator provides a preliminary estimate based on your area and services. Prices marked “from” are starting rates. The final price, scope and schedule are agreed after discussing your needs.

about.title: About the studio
about.subtitle: Design Seichas — interior design with attention to layout, light and everyday life.
story: We develop interior design projects for apartments and houses. We begin with your needs: how you use the space, what you want to change and what you need the project to deliver.

The scope depends on your chosen package. Layouts, working drawings, collages and photorealistic visualisations are available in different combinations. Design supervision, procurement and implementation are discussed and charged separately.
The first discussion can take place online. A plan, photographs and your preferences are useful starting materials. After understanding the brief, we agree on the scope and project terms.
